sources.excerpt: Cool Cat Distortion by Danelectro | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Danelectro Cool Cat Distortion LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description The Cool Cat CD-1 Distortion from Danelectro gives you a metal stomp box for the price of a plastic one. If you’re finicky about tone, the Cool Cat will have you purring. The Cool Cat Distortion brings all the rage of a cranked British tube amp to your tone. Since the 60’s, the definitive sound of Rock from London to Tokyo. An extremely versatile pedal.
